'''Original Fizzyglug ''' was a variant of the [[Fizzyglug]] beverage sold<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restuarant]] in Coruscant's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] neighborhood, sold various versions of Fizzyglug including Original Fizzyglug for 1.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The diner also offered to add flavored syrups to the beverage at no additional charge. These syrups included [[bilaberry]], [[Denta bean/Legends|denta bean]], [[Geldan sun-apple]], [[Ishi Tib-cracked coconut]], [[Jewel-fruit (Mon Calamari)|jewel-fruit]], [[manta pear]], [[nikkle nut]], [[Pallie/Legends|pallie]], [[Roonan lemon]], [[scry-mint]], [[Shuura/Legends|shuura fruit]], [[Sunberry/Legends|sunberry]], [[sweetmelon]], [[Trammistan chocolate]], [[zherry]], and [[zwil]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Original Fizzyglug was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
